en: Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a cobblestone main street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. A tall church tower with a clock and spire dominates the right side in the middle distance. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. German text is printed at the top identifying the location, and business signs are visible on the buildings.
